reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs so no unintended edit was introduced.

The cited text supports the conclusion: neither Section 4(a) nor Section 5 imposes a stipulated sum, penalty, minimum-fee-on-termination, or accelerated remaining-contract-value payment on the Customer (AP). Section 4(a) only preserves Kubient's entitlement to fees actually 'generated during the termination period' (its share under the Section 5 revenue-share, where Kubient remits to Customer), which is ordinary earned compensation rather than liquidated damages.

No Customer-payable LD trigger appears elsewhere in the supplied material, and Section 7(a)'s mutual exclusion of punitive/similar damages further supports the preferred position; the rationale appropriately notes the agreement is silent rather than expressly disclaiming, which is a non-flaggable sub-element under the classification rules.
Deterministic checks are empty, consistent with a no-edit compliant finding; retaining this as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue is correct.
